story.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛赢家与输家盘点
story.summaryZh: The 比赛团队对2026年F1西班牙大奖赛进行赢家与输家盘点，指出在马德里赛道的首场F1比赛中真正的赢家不多，连获胜者本人都觉得自己应该排在第二位。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
story.summaryEn: The Race team reviews the winners and losers from the 2026 Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, noting that there were not many true winners at the first F1 race at the Madring, and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
detailZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛没有多少赢家——甚至真正的比赛获胜者都觉得自己其实应该排在第二位。
以下是我们完整的赢家与输家盘点。
一场本应赢下的比赛，因此也不应该有一辆车只拿到第八名。真是办公室里的艰难一天。
虚拟安全车让赛道上除兰多·诺里斯之外的每辆车都获得了优势，这是唯一的问题。他开得几乎完美，擦到7号弯护墙是他唯一的瑕疵，看起来他已经稳操胜券，却在之后被夺走。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的比赛要复杂得多。第一圈与乔治·拉塞尔碰撞导致的受损前翼到底对他有多大影响？而他在最后阶段被加布里埃尔·博托莱托和弗兰科·科拉平托挡在身后，究竟该归咎于他缺乏速度、进站，还是迈凯伦的策略团队？车队选择让他进站，明知他可能被困在那群车中。
皮亚斯特里在2026款赛车上相对诺里斯一直很挣扎，但即便在这种情况下，这个周末也感觉很糟糕。——杰克·贝尼昂
刘易斯·汉密尔顿起步时确实没有犯错。他起步比马克斯·维斯塔潘快，荷兰人在切过开场减速弯后最终不得不让出位置。
随后长长的刹车踏板行程迅速变成故障，汉密尔顿不得不停下他的法拉利。
“进入5号弯刹车时，我踩了刹车，车开始减速，然后踏板突然一沉，车没有像正常那样快速减速，我最终带着很高的速度冲了进去……擦到了护墙。”
“之后踏板恢复了，一切正常，但几个弯之后踏板又变长了。真的不知道这是从哪里来的，”这是汉密尔顿的事后分析。
本可能是领奖台的成绩变成了退赛，这位车手随后承认安东内利在冠军争夺中不可阻挡。
考虑到迈凯伦的研发速度，这对法拉利来说可能是一次刺痛的积分损失——他们在争夺年度亚军的优势现在缩小到了52分。——萨马斯·卡纳尔
又一场比赛，又一个冠军给基米·安东内利——又一次利用了虚拟安全车。
安东内利这次不需要在赛道上超车，因为首先杆位得主诺里斯的比赛因虚拟安全车出动时机稍晚而崩盘，他晚一圈的进站也很慢。
然后查尔斯·勒克莱尔因放弃了虚拟安全车期间的进站，不得不在比赛后期让出领先位置。
低轮胎磨损、缺乏超车机会以及迈凯伦不幸的时机和糟糕的策略，使这场比赛成为安东内利本赛季最不引人注目的胜利。
他在胜利中表现得很有风度，说他为诺里斯“感到有点难过”，并称这位迈凯伦车手本应是当之无愧的赢家。
凭借这场胜利，梅赛德斯追平法拉利，成为动力单元制造商中大奖赛胜场最多的品牌（251胜）。
更重要的是，安东内利目前积292分，而队友乔治·拉塞尔为211分。
他有望以相当大的优势成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。——SK
这位马德里赛道赛事大使从未期待过一场特别有竞争力的主场比赛，但他本希望周日不会像这样充满事故。
第一圈开始，他笨拙地撞上了角田裕毅的小红牛，随后又将同胞费尔南多·阿隆索挤到墙上。
幸运的是，卡洛斯·塞恩斯至少能在退赛前服完处罚——所以不会带到巴库——但这为这个令人失望且草率的周末画上了句号。——乔什·萨蒂尔
在蒙扎的最坏情况之后，人们曾希望马德里赛道能为阿斯顿·马丁提供一个更好的机会，像在赞德沃特那样争夺积分。
但这从未实现，也看起来不太可能。他肯定没有得到帮助，因为阿隆索被塞恩斯挤压后带着损伤，这使得很难知道阿斯顿·马丁在这里的真实潜力。
“今天引擎非常糟糕，”阿隆索说。“我认为今天的增压控制很困难。我在进站时差点熄火。”
“还有蓝旗的时候，让车减速。引擎在那之后很难恢复，所以我在蓝旗上损失了很多时间。”
他最终落后两圈，以第17名完赛，而兰斯·斯特罗尔在57圈比赛的第15圈就驶离了赛道。——JS
科拉平托以第七名领跑中游集团，表现稳健。
他带领一列中游赛车在斯特罗尔引发的虚拟安全车期间进站，然后在最后阶段向博托莱托施压并挡住了皮亚斯特里。
虽然一度与皮亚斯特里的差距是三秒——科拉平托在压力下面对一辆快得多的赛车时巧妙地扩大了差距——但差距在最后确实缩小了。但这并不改变这一成就的分量。
科拉平托现在在车手积分榜上仅落后第11名的阿尔维德·林德布拉德四分，而阿尔派在争夺车队第五名时与小红牛的差距已从13分缩小到9分。——JB
马德里赛道这个周末做了很多正确的事，但很难将首场F1比赛描述为除了沉闷之外的任何东西。
赛道缺乏超车机会肯定没有帮助，缺乏显著的轮胎磨损也没有帮助。
但也许最痛苦的是，这正是许多F1车手在布局公布时警告会发生的情况。
所以，尽管马德里赛道做了很多伟大的事情，首届赛事最可能被记住的，是它令人失望的周日产品。——JS
detailEn: Not many winners from Formula 1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix - and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
Here's our full winners and losers rundown.
A race it should have won, and therefore not had a car finishing eighth in, either. A really tough day at the office.

The VSC giving an advantage to every other car on track apart from Lando Norris was the sole issue. He drove almost perfectly, a clip of the Turn 7 wall his only blemish as he appeared to have the race sewn up before it was taken from him.

Oscar Piastri's race was much more complicated. How much did the damaged wing from clashing with George Russell on lap one really hamper him? And was it his lack of pace, the pitstop, or McLaren's strategy bods to blame for him being caught behind Gabriel Bortoleto and Franco Colapinto in the closing stages? It chose to pit him, knowing being stuck in that pack was a possibility.
Piastri has struggled relative to Norris with the 2026 car, but this felt like a poor weekend even in the circumstances. - Jack Benyon
Lewis Hamilton didn't really put a foot wrong at the start. He was quicker than Max Verstappen off the line and the Dutchman did eventually have to concede after cutting the opening chicane.
Then a long brake pedal quickly turned into a malfunction and Hamilton had to stop his Ferrari.

"Braking into Turn 5, I had hit the brake, the car started stopping and then the pedal took a step and the car didn't decelerate as fast as it would normally and I ended up carrying a lot of speed in and… brushed the barrier.
"After that, the pedal came back, it was fine, and then a few corners later the pedal went long. Don't really know where that's come from," was Hamilton's post-mortem.
What could have been a podium finish turned into a DNF for the driver, who then conceded that Antonelli was unstoppable in the title race.
Given McLaren's rate of development, it could prove to be a stinging points loss for Ferrari - whose advantage in their fight for second in the championship is now down to 52 points. - Samarth Kanal
Another race, another win for Kimi Antonelli - and another VSC capitalised upon.
Antonelli didn't need to make an overtake on track for this one, as first polesitter Norris's race unravelled as the VSC was deployed a moment too late and his pitstop one lap later was slow.
Then Charles Leclerc had to relinquish the lead late in the race having forgone the VSC pitstop.
Low tyre degradation, a lack of overtaking opportunities and McLaren's unfortunate timing and poor strategy made this one Antonelli's least remarkable win of the season.
He was gracious in victory, saying he "felt a bit bad" for Norris and that the McLaren driver would've been the deserving winner.
With victory here, Mercedes has tied Ferrari for most grand prix wins by a power unit manufacturer (251).
More consequentially, Antonelli is on 292 points to team-mate George Russell's 211.
He's on course to become F1's youngest world champion by some margin. - SK
The Madring event ambassador was never expecting a particularly competitive home grand prix, but he'd have hoped for better than an incident-filled Sunday.
It began on lap one with a rather clumsy first lap where he clunked into Yuki Tsunoda's Racing Bulls, and was followed by squeezing his fellow countryman Fernando Alonso into the wall.
Thankfully Carlos Sainz was at least able to serve that penalty before he retired - so it won't carry over to Baku - but it rounded off a disappointing and sloppy weekend. - Josh Suttill
After the worst-case scenario at Monza, there was hope the Madring would provide a better chance for Aston Martin to challenge for points like at Zandvoort.

But it never materialised nor looked likely. He certainly wasn't helped by Alonso carrying damage from Sainz squeezing him, and that makes it particularly hard to know the true potential of the Aston Martin here.
"The engine was very bad today," Alonso said. "I think the boost control was difficult today. I nearly stalled on the pitstops.
"With some of the blue flags as well, letting the people go and slowing down. The engine was struggling to recover after that, so I was losing a lot of time on the blue flags.
He ultimately finished two laps down in 17th while Lance Stroll pulled off the track 15 laps into the 57-lap race. - JS
Colapinto led the midfield with an accomplished drive to seventh.
He led a train of mid-pack cars that pitted under the Stroll-induced VSC, and then pressured Bortoleto and held off Piastri in the closing stages.

While the gap was three seconds at one point to Piastri - expertly extended by Colapinto under pressure from what was a much quicker car - it did come down towards the end. But that doesn't change the scale of the achievement.

Colapinto's only four points off 11th-placed Arvid Lindblad in the drivers' championship now, and Alpine's gap to Racing Bulls in the chase for fifth in the constructors' has reduced from 13 to nine. - JB
The Madring did plenty right this weekend, but it's difficult to describe the first F1 race as anything but dull.
The lack of overtaking opportunities around the circuit certainly didn't help, nor did the lack of significant tyre degradation.
But what's perhaps most painful is that this is exactly what many F1 drivers warned would happen when the layout was revealed.
So for all the great things the Madring has done, the first event will most likely be best remembered for its underwhelming Sunday product. - JS

安东内利目前积292分，领先队友拉塞尔211分，有望成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
科拉平托以第七名领跑中游集团，阿尔派在车队积分榜上追近小红牛，差距从13分缩小到9分。
keyPointsEn: After Antonelli's win, Mercedes tied Ferrari for most grand prix wins by a power unit manufacturer with 251.
Antonelli now has 292 points to teammate Russell's 211 and is on course to become F1's youngest world champion by some margin.
Colapinto led the midfield with a seventh-place finish, and Alpine's gap to Racing Bulls in the fight for fifth in the constructors' championship has reduced from 13 to nine points.

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.
